Preserve unchanged the original open smiling mouth with tongue visible, head direction, eyebrows, nose, face silhouette, ears, hair, neck and white collar unless the following primary edit specifically says otherwise. Do not change that wrist/forearm or replace the placeholder with a finished flashlight. Freeze the torso, waist, lower body and every white dot and fold in the yellow dress. Approximate native-pixel iris/pupil center targets are (376,361) and (519,367), instead of roughly (360,365) and (501,371). These are guidance for a coherent gaze, not dots to draw. The original tongue smile must remain. BOTH hands, their exact original positions, the gray flashlight cylinder and the single tan rod are completely unchanged. This is an intentional look toward her own puppet, not a head turn.
